channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Scrutiny intensifies on Edison as DA investigation, pay cuts, earnings announced
item.description: Rosemead-based Edison International's earnings and revenue increased this year over last year, the company announced this week. But an L.A. County probe over the Eaton fire and pay cuts for executives brought more focus on the utility giant.

item.title: Gavin Newsom and AOC: Two Democrats, Two Auditions
item.description: Looking past primary politics, the California governor stayed in his lane by projecting the appearance of a potential president.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: His family says he spent his final days with loved ones.

item.title: Genesis Invitational: Rory McIlroy handles rain, wind to share clubhouse lead at Riviera
item.description: McIlroy deals with a little bit of everything on his way to a 5-under-par 66, matching Jacob Bridgeman for the first-round lead. Aaron Rai is one shot ahead but has two holes left after play was suspended. Scottie Scheffler is 5-over with eight holes left.

item.title: Alexander: At least the rain has left Riviera … we think
item.description: After a 3-hour rain delay early in the day, most of the field gets a full first round in as the PGA Tour – and most of its biggest names – returns to Pacific Palisades after a year away.

item.title: CPUC should allow the Charter-Cox merger to proceed
item.description: California should not make itself an outlier when it comes to internet service.

item.title: 3 women detained at Irvine business days before anti-ICE protest on Friday
item.description: The protest, organized by 50501, a nationwide group critical of the Trump administration, is planned for Friday morning outside ICE's new Irvine office.

item.title: USC gets a scare as Jazzy Davidson exits late in victory over Wisconsin
item.description: The star freshman, who scores 24 points, is carried to the locker room in the fourth quarter but appears fine after the 66-59 victory, the Trojans’ sixth straight.

item.title: Lauren Betts powers UCLA past Washington to clinch a share of Big Ten title
item.description: Betts has 23 points and eight rebounds as the second-ranked Bruins (26-1 overall, 16-0 Big Ten) win their 20th consecutive game, 82-67. They can win the title outright by beating Wisconsin at home on Sunday.

item.title: Bennedict Mathurin shines as surging Clippers hold off Nuggets
item.description: Mathurin scores a career-high 38 points in his Clippers home debut, Kawhi Leonard scores 23, and they hang on for a 115-114 win to move within one game of a .500 record.
